Roles and permissions

Build prompt

Build “Live Event Day Command Center” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Use a stable check-in identifier to deduplicate retries. Stream count and incident changes, show the connection state, and reconcile missed events after reconnect. Check-in volunteers record arrivals. Assigned leads own incidents. Event managers see counts and presence. Shared displays contain aggregate counts only. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

With 20 attendees checked in, scan one pass twice on two devices. The shared count reaches 21. Assigning an incident updates the lead’s dashboard while the shared display omits the incident details.
